name: @pipeworx/mcp-tradier

tools.name: tradier_option_chain
tools.description: Get the option chain (strikes, greeks, IV, open interest) for <symbol> expiring <expiration>. Returns every call and put at that expiration with bid/ask/last, volume, open interest, and greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega/IV). Example: tradier_option_chain({ symbol: "AAPL", expiration: "2026-01-16", _apiKey: "your-token" })

expiration.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-01-16" (use tradier_option_expirations to list valid dates)

sandbox.description: Use the Tradier sandbox environment (sandbox.tradier.com) instead of production. Default false.

_apiKey.description: Tradier access token (free with a funded Tradier brokerage account, or a sandbox token)

tools.name: tradier_option_expirations
tools.description: List the available option expiration dates for <symbol>. Returns an array of YYYY-MM-DD dates you can pass to tradier_option_chain. Example: tradier_option_expirations({ symbol: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your-token" })

sandbox.description: Use the Tradier sandbox environment (sandbox.tradier.com) instead of production. Default false.

_apiKey.description: Tradier access token (free with a funded Tradier brokerage account, or a sandbox token)

tools.name: tradier_quote
tools.description: Get real-time quotes for <symbols> (last price, bid, ask, volume, change). Accepts one or more comma-separated tickers. Example: tradier_quote({ symbols: "AAPL,MSFT,SPY", _apiKey: "your-token" })

symbols.description: One or more ticker symbols, comma-separated, e.g. "AAPL" or "AAPL,MSFT,SPY"

sandbox.description: Use the Tradier sandbox environment (sandbox.tradier.com) instead of production. Default false.

_apiKey.description: Tradier access token (free with a funded Tradier brokerage account, or a sandbox token)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tradier forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tradier pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
